display_long_description:
# 😺 Run a Cat Supermarket  
Open the doors, fill the shelves, scan the items, and take the money. Work fast, work slow, run a clean little shop, or turn it into a busy cat-powered market. It is your store.

[media]

# 😺 Breed Cats  
Put two cats together and see what kind of kitten you get. Keep the cute ones, sell the valuable ones, or try again for a rare coat. Your cat family is your business.

[media]

# 😺 Collect Every Coat  
Every cat color has a spot in your Tablet. Find a new coat, light it up, and keep going until the whole page is full.


# 😺 Hire Cat Employees  
Cats can work too. Put them in your store and let them help you earn money. But cats will not work for free forever. If they get too tired, they may run away.

[media]

# 😺 Scratch Lottery Tickets  
Sell tickets to customers, or scratch them yourself. Play it safe and make steady money, or chase the lucky ticket that could make your day.

[media]

# 😺 Keep Your Favorite Cats  
Keep your favorite cats in special Cat Zones. Let them walk around, rest, and stay near you while you work. Sell the others, keep the best, or try to collect them all.

# 😺 Expand Your Supermarket  
Buy more products, make your store bigger, and upgrade your shop. Build a small cozy store, a busy supermarket, or the biggest Meow Mart on the block.

Join our Discord and become a Shareholder — vote on what we build next! https://discord.gg/at5QaPDjvg
